releaseNotes: 🎵 True Dual-Player Seamless Playback: Symmetric Active & Secondary audio slots eliminate tail replays, audio gaps, and stalls during track transitions.
⚡ Early ~10s Silent Preloading: Next track stream & decoder prepare silently at 0% volume around 10 seconds into playback without interrupting the current song.
♾️ Zero-Overlap Gapless Playback (0s): Preloads incoming tracks ahead of track end for instantaneous gapless transitions even when crossfade is set to 0s.
🌊 True Equal-Power Crossfade: Smooth cos/sin overlap curves keep perceived loudness constant while preserving full 10-band EQ & Bass Boost across handovers.
🛡️ Resilient Controls & Recovery: Pause/resume mid-crossfade pauses both players cleanly, isolated preload errors never stop active music, and shuffle reorders upcoming queue items.
🎵 True Dual-Player Architecture: Independent Active & Secondary ExoPlayer slots with atomic MediaSession handovers.
⚡ Early ~10s Silent Preloading: Decodes and buffers incoming tracks silently without interrupting current playback.
♾️ Gapless Playback (0s) & Equal-Power Crossfade: Instantaneous zero-overlap cuts or constant-power cos/sin crossfades.
🎛️ Equalizer Continuity: User 10-band EQ, Bass Boost, and Virtualizer settings persist seamlessly across every track handover.
🔀 Shuffle & Isolated Recovery: Real upcoming queue shuffle and isolated secondary preload error handling.
